correctness.rationale: Frobenius factors the Laurent polynomial by digits; a zero exponent forces the lowest signed digit to be zero since its magnitude is at most four, and then iteratively forces all to be zero. The five single-digit values yield weights (1,1,3,2,4). Equivalently to the character argument, their counting measure is the sum of a point mass at 1 and the all-ones measure on the four-unit group; convolution raises the total mass to 5^j and leaves the coefficient of the point mass equal to 1. A carry through exactly t fours contributes (-1)^t in the old residue, and the unique next digit is determined by the ratio v/u since the four digit quotients are 1,3,4,2 for even t and their negatives for odd t. The resulting distinguished old residues reconstruct both printed lookup vectors. Summing the uniform prefix terms gives the stated baseline; the separate endpoint is ((−1)^L,1), not an additional free-prefix case. For L≥2 the eight parity-adjusted cells are distinct, include the endpoint, and each has positive deviation since floor(L/2)>(4L+1)/16. Their positive deviations sum to (4L+1)/2 and normalization yields the claimed TV. The unadjusted baseline is at least 1 for L≥2; L=0 has one occupied cell and L=1 has five distinct occupied cells, giving TV 15/16 and 11/16. Independent direct polynomial multiplication modulo five through n=625, with no use of digit products for the observed counts, recovered all cells and the exact TV for L=0 through 4 (`python3 -B /workspace/branches/bounded_review_checks.py 4`). The packaged check through L=7 was inspected, not executed; the unrestricted result follows from the symbolic proof.
